diffusionModel.description: The H3 Omni-Transformer, loaded by ComfyUI's UNETLoader. This default is the full, un-pruned fl2va checkpoint: the pruned variants drop the AdaLN branches, and a LoRA trained against the full base only reaches them through a runtime re-injection the node has to guess at. fl2va is the checkpoint that serves text-to-video and first/last-frame video; ref2va is a different set of weights.

ref2vaModel.description: The ref2va transformer, loaded by the same UNETLoader for ref2v jobs: up to nine reference images the prompt cites as <Picture 1>..<Picture 9>. Not read at start -- an arm without it runs fl2v, and a ref2v job names the missing file. The Turbo LoRA was trained on the fl2va line; on ref2va it is applied the same way and has not been measured.

textEncoder.description: Qwen3-VL 32B, whose 50th-layer hidden states are H3's conditioning. The full weights, not a pruned encoder: H3 adds its own special tokens and the tokenizer configuration that comes with the ComfyUI repack is the one the model was trained against.

videoVae.description: H3-VisualVAE: 16x spatial, 4x temporal, 24 latent channels. Also the VAE that encodes a first or last frame into the keyframe latent.

audioVae.description: H3-AudioVAE. The clip's stereo track is denoised jointly with the picture and decoded here, which is why there is a second VAE at all.

turboLora.description: The MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA. This default is the v4 step-600 EMA file for a full base -- the pruned/curve-form conversions are for a pruned checkpoint and will not reproduce it. Four to eight steps instead of twenty; this arm exists for that schedule.

outputDir.description: Root that every job output path is confined to.

inputDir.description: Root that a job's keyframe images are confined to. ComfyUI is given this as its own input directory, so a reference is named relative to it and nothing outside it can be read.

scratchDir.description: Where ComfyUI keeps its own output, temp and user files. Nothing here is the library's; finished clips are moved out of it.

weightDtype.description: How the transformer is cast as it is read. default is correct for the int8_convrot checkpoint, which carries its own quantisation -- casting that to fp8 would quantise it twice. Only a bf16 checkpoint has anything to gain here.

textEncoderDevice.description: cpu keeps Qwen3-VL 32B off the card. On a 16 GiB card that is most of the reason a clip fits at all, at the cost of a slower prompt encode once per job.

loraMode.description: bypass applies the LoRA at run time as Wx + BAx, which is what the adapter was measured on. merge folds it into the weights: lowest peak VRAM, and softer on a quantised base because the update is partly rounded away.

vramMode.description: dynamic is ComfyUI's own memory manager, which streams whatever will not fit -- and on a 16 GiB card against a 33B transformer, that is most of it. The rest pin its behaviour.

attention.description: Attention backend. sage roughly halves the sampling time on this model and needs its own wheel in this arm's venv.

reserveVram.description: GiB left to the desktop compositor. Too little and Windows starts evicting the model behind ComfyUI's back.

cacheMode.description: What ComfyUI keeps between prompts. ram is its default; none re-runs every node each time, which throws away the cached prompt encode a batch of clips depends on.

extraArgs.description: Extra ComfyUI command line flags, split on whitespace and passed through verbatim.
